The '''Sentient Beings Opposing Violence''' was a peace organization, that operated during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they organized a conference in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], with the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==History==
The SBOV was established roughly ten years before the Clone Wars and aimed to stop aggression and violence throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They viewed the Jedi Order as a dangerous, state-sanctioned cult, so during the Clone Wars, they organized a conference with the Jedi in the Cularin system, aboard the ''[[Luxury]]'', a liner. However, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]] disrupted the conference and tried to use [[t'salak]]s to enrage the visiting Jedi and cause them to attack the SBOV delegates.
